summary: The WebRender bindings were updated to better support EGL/ANGLE and Metal: separate eglCreateSync entrypoints were exposed, the render-thread GL context can be created with EGL when Metal ANGLE is enabled, and the render-backend pool was plumbed into Gecko so multiple windows can share backend threads. Memory-leak fixes and MacIOSurface-to-EGL texture binding support were included, improving stability and enabling the cross-platform ANGLE path.
